t.rel: A large island country off southeastern Africa. After the military took power in 2025, its African Union membership was suspended.
t.know: Most of its plants and animals are found nowhere else on Earth.
t.etext: The world's largest vanilla producer, it also sells nickel, cobalt and clothing. Most people are poor, and cyclones strike often.
